three_root_causes_resolved: 1. CAC-BC roof panels IfcCovering PredefinedType='CEILING' -> 'CLADDING' so dcgrade classifies them as 'containment' and exempts in-aisle sprinklers SP-095..104 from clear_height (10 -> 0 violations).

2. Corner/tee joint endpoint trim by W/2 + 20 mm leaves a ~20 mm surface-to-surface gap (> 2 mm clash tolerance, < 250 mm joint_tolerance_mm), taking same-service corner clashes from 18 -> 0 while preserving 1 connected component per service.

3. Concentric non-crossing 3-snake plan topology (CHW-1 outer, BW-1 middle, CT-1 inner with >= 344.5 mm horizontal separation from BW-1) eliminates all plan overlaps (_plan_overlaps == False), taking tray_stack_headroom and power_telecom_separation violations to 0.
